description: This file defines the `ContainerRuntimeLoader` class, which lazily loads Twig runtime implementations from a PSR-11 container, implementing the `RuntimeLoaderInterface`. It is part of the Twig template engine's runtime loading system.

classes.name: ContainerRuntimeLoader
classes.description: A class that loads Twig runtime implementations lazily using a PSR-11 container.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the loader with a PSR-11 container.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a runtime class instance from the container if available.
